Name: fdm_hole_shrink
Comment: FDM holes always print smaller than modeled due to filament expansion and layer resolution. Add to all hole sketch diameters or apply via Offset Face. Measure a 10 mm test circle: shrink = 10.0 − actual_diameter. Update per machine.

Name: fdm_outer_oversize
Comment: FDM outer surfaces print 0.05–0.20 mm larger than modeled due to extrusion pressure. Subtract from shaft and boss ODs for precise fits. Measure a 20 mm calibration cube in X and Y.

Name: fdm_layer_height
Comment: Default layer height. Base unit for teardrop compensation, bridge sag, and fillet minimums. Update when switching profiles — all derived params follow.

Name: fdm_first_layer_height
Comment: First layer printed thicker for bed adhesion. Relevant for total Z stack height calculations.

Name: fdm_line_width
Comment: Actual deposited extrusion line width — typically nozzle_dia × 1.10–1.15. All wall thickness and bridge span calcs derive from this. Re-measure after any nozzle change.

Name: fdm_elephant_foot
Comment: First-layer squish bulge on outer perimeter — typically 0.10–0.20 mm. Subtract from bottom-surface mating features (flanges, bases) so they sit flush. Dial in with a single-layer calibration square.

Name: fdm_seam_protrusion
Comment: Small Z-seam protrusion at layer start. Matters on outer mating surfaces. Either orient seam to a non-mating edge, or add this allowance to surface-critical fits.

Name: fdm_min_infill_width
Comment: Below this pocket width, infill skips entirely and bridges. Account for this in thin pocket features — infill may not fill them at all.

Name: fdm_solid_top_layers
Comment: Number of solid top layers before a press-fit or heat-set mating surface for best dimensional accuracy. Fewer layers = rougher surface = worse fit.

Name: fdm_nozzle_dia
Comment: Base nozzle diameter. Line width and wall thickness derivations should reference this. Change when switching nozzles.

Name: fdm_nozzle_06
Comment: 0.6mm nozzle diameter for fast structural prints. Line width ~0.66mm.

Name: fdm_nozzle_08
Comment: 0.8mm nozzle for maximum strength and speed. Line width ~0.88mm.

Name: fdm_layer_012
Comment: Fine detail layer height. For cosmetic surfaces and small text. Slower but sharper features.

Name: fdm_layer_016
Comment: Balanced detail/speed layer height. Good compromise for visible functional parts.

Name: fdm_layer_028
Comment: Draft/fast layer height for 0.4mm nozzle. Maximum practical layer for rapid prototyping.

Name: fdm_support_angle
Comment: Angle from vertical below which supports are needed. Complement of overhang_max (90-45=45).

Name: fdm_support_gap_z
Comment: Z gap between support interface and part bottom. Typically 1 layer height for easy removal.

Name: fdm_support_gap_xy
Comment: XY gap between support walls and part walls. Prevents fusion while maintaining proximity.

Name: tol_fine
Comment: ISO 2768 fine class (f) — general linear tolerance ±0.05 mm per side for 3–30 mm features. Requires a well-calibrated machine.

Name: tol_medium
Comment: ISO 2768 medium class (m) — ±0.10 mm per side for 3–30 mm. Default starting point for most functional FDM parts.

Name: tol_coarse
Comment: ISO 2768 coarse class (c) — ±0.20 mm per side. For non-critical features or lower-accuracy machines.

Name: tol_angular
Comment: General angular tolerance. Matches ISO 2768 medium angular class for 0–10 mm leg length. Critical angles (e.g. 45° for no-support printing) should be exactly constrained.

Name: fdm_sliding_fit
Comment: FDM-practical sliding fit clearance per mating surface (total gap = 0.30 mm). Equivalent to coarse H8/e8 adapted for FDM variation. Use for lids, sliding panels, guide channels.

Name: fdm_press_fit
Comment: FDM light press fit per mating surface (total gap = 0.10 mm). Requires deliberate hand force. Good for retained pins and press-in bushings.

Name: fdm_interference_fit
Comment: FDM interference fit — hole modeled smaller than shaft by this per side. Requires significant force or press. Most reliable with TPU or small features.

Name: tol_h7g6_running
Comment: ISO H7/g6 running clearance fit reference. Only achievable by post-machining or reaming in FDM context. Provided as a design target.

Name: fdm_min_hole_dia
Comment: Minimum FDM hole diameter without post-processing. Smaller holes are often malformed — model at 1.5 mm and drill to final size.

Name: fdm_teardrop_offset
Comment: Upward Z offset for horizontal holes to compensate overhang droop. Shift hole center up by this, or use teardrop profile.

Name: fdm_hole_compensation
Comment: Add to all circle sketch diameters, or Offset Face after modeling. References printer_accuracy_hole_shrink_compensation.

Name: m3_selftap_hole
Comment: Hole diameter for direct M3 screw into plastic (self-tapping, no insert). Use for low-load non-serviceable joints. Engagement length ≥ 8 mm recommended.

Name: m4_selftap_hole
Comment: Hole diameter for direct M4 self-tapping into plastic.

Name: fdm_thread_engage_min
Comment: Minimum thread engagement length for reliable printed threads under moderate load. Rule of thumb: 1× bolt diameter minimum, 2× for structural. At M3 that is 3–6 mm.

Name: m2_thru_hole
Comment: M2 bolt clearance through-hole. ISO M2 shank = 2.0 mm + 0.40 mm FDM clearance.

Name: m2_close_fit_hole
Comment: M2 close-fit location hole — for alignment and indexed dowels.

Name: m2_boss_od
Comment: M2 boss OD — cylindrical pad surrounding M2 hole. 2× screw diameter rule.

Name: m2p5_thru_hole
Comment: M2.5 bolt clearance through-hole. ISO M2.5 shank = 2.5 mm + 0.40 mm. Raspberry Pi / SBC standard fastener.

Name: m2p5_close_fit_hole
Comment: M2.5 close-fit location hole.

Name: m2p5_boss_od
Comment: M2.5 boss OD — standard for SBC and PCB mounting posts.

Name: m3_thru_hole
Comment: M3 bolt clearance through-hole. Voron project standard. ISO M3 shank = 3.0 mm + 0.40 mm.

Name: m3_close_fit_hole
Comment: M3 close-fit location hole.

Name: m3_boss_od
Comment: M3 boss OD — Voron standard. ~1.5 mm wall around clearance hole.

Name: m4_thru_hole
Comment: M4 bolt clearance through-hole. ISO M4 = 4.0 mm + 0.50 mm.

Name: m4_close_fit_hole
Comment: M4 close-fit location hole.

Name: m4_boss_od
Comment: M4 boss OD — 2× screw diameter, ~1.75 mm wall.

Name: m5_thru_hole
Comment: M5 bolt clearance through-hole. ISO M5 = 5.0 mm + 0.50 mm.

Name: m5_close_fit_hole
Comment: M5 close-fit location hole.

Name: m5_boss_od
Comment: M5 boss OD.

Name: m6_thru_hole
Comment: M6 bolt clearance through-hole.

Name: m6_close_fit_hole
Comment: M6 close-fit location hole.

Name: m6_boss_od
Comment: M6 boss OD.

Name: m2_heatset_hole
Comment: M2 heat-set hole ID. ~98% of insert OD. Measure your batch.

Name: m2_heatset_depth
Comment: M2 recess depth = insert length + 0.20 mm.

Name: m3_heatset_hole
Comment: M3 heat-set hole ID — Voron standard Ruthex M3×5×4 (OD=4.5 mm). 98% of OD.

Name: m3_heatset_depth
Comment: M3 recess depth — 4.0 mm insert + 0.20 mm flush margin.

Name: m3_heatset_boss_od
Comment: M3 heat-set boss OD — slightly larger than plain M3 boss to handle insert knurling pressure.

Name: m4_heatset_hole
Comment: M4 heat-set hole ID (Ruthex RX-M4×6 OD≈5.6 mm). Always measure batch.

Name: m4_heatset_depth
Comment: M4 recess depth = 6.0 mm insert + 0.20 mm.

Name: m5_heatset_hole
Comment: M5 heat-set hole ID. Verify OD of your specific insert brand.

Name: heatset_temp_pla
Comment: Soldering iron tip temp for PLA heat-set installation. Use a dedicated brass insert tip.

Name: heatset_temp_petg
Comment: Iron tip temp for PETG heat-set installation.

Name: heatset_temp_abs_asa
Comment: Iron tip temp for ABS/ASA heat-set installation.

Name: m2_socket_head_height
Comment: M2 socket cap head height.

Name: m2p5_socket_head_dia
Comment: M2.5 socket cap head OD.

Name: m2p5_socket_head_height

Name: m3_socket_head_dia
Comment: M3 socket cap head OD. Slightly narrower than button — useful where lateral clearance is tight.

Name: m3_socket_head_height

Name: m4_socket_head_height

Comment: M5 socket cap head OD.

Comment: M5 socket cap head height.

Comment: M3 flat-head socket screw (DIN 7991 / ISO 10642) head OD.

Name: m3_flat_head_height
Comment: M3 flat-head head height (below flush surface).

Name: m4_flat_head_dia
Comment: M4 flat-head head OD.

Name: m5_flat_head_dia
Comment: M5 flat-head head OD.

Name: m2_hex_nut_af
Comment: M2 hex nut AF (ISO 4032).

Name: m2_hex_nut_height
Comment: M2 hex nut height.

Name: m2p5_hex_nut_af
Comment: M2.5 hex nut AF.

Name: m2p5_hex_nut_height
Comment: M2.5 hex nut height.

Comment: M3 hex nut AF. Standard for Voron nut traps. FDM pocket: model at 5.70 mm.

Name: m3_hex_nut_height
Comment: M3 hex nut height. FDM pocket depth: model at 2.60 mm.

Name: m4_hex_nut_af
Comment: M4 hex nut AF.

Name: m4_hex_nut_height

Name: m5_hex_nut_af
Comment: M5 hex nut AF.

Name: m5_hex_nut_height
Comment: M5 hex nut height.

Name: m3_square_nut_width
Comment: M3 square nut (DIN 557) width. FDM trap: 5.70 mm slot.

Name: m3_square_nut_height
Comment: M3 square nut height. FDM trap depth: 2.00 mm.

Name: m4_square_nut_width
Comment: M4 square nut width.

Name: m4_square_nut_height
Comment: M4 square nut height.

Name: m3_washer_od
Comment: M3 flat washer OD (ISO 7089 normal series).

Name: m3_washer_thick
Comment: M3 flat washer thickness.

Name: m4_washer_od
Comment: M4 flat washer OD.

Name: m5_washer_od
Comment: M5 flat washer OD.

Name: m3_dowel_pin_dia
Comment: ISO 8734 dowel pin h6 class — 3 mm nominal. For precision alignment features. FDM receiver hole: 3.10–3.15 mm for clearance fit, or post-ream for press fit.

Name: m4_dowel_pin_dia
Comment: 4 mm ISO dowel pin nominal diameter.

Name: m5_dowel_pin_dia
Comment: 5 mm ISO dowel pin nominal diameter.

Name: fdm_dowel_clearance
Comment: Add to dowel pin nominal diameter for a printed clearance receiver hole — part self-aligns but pin is not retained. For retention, drill and ream to H7.

Name: m3_standoff_od
Comment: M3 hex standoff OD — standard brass or aluminum spacers. Used for PCB mount boss sizing and clearance calculations.

Name: m2p5_standoff_od
Comment: M2.5 hex standoff OD.

Name: ziptie_2p5mm_width
Comment: Standard 2.5 mm zip tie slot width with FDM clearance. For cable management routing channels.

Name: ziptie_2p5mm_thick
Comment: Standard 2.5 mm zip tie slot thickness with FDM clearance.

Name: ziptie_3p5mm_width
Comment: Standard 3.5 mm zip tie slot width with FDM clearance.

Name: ziptie_3p5mm_thick
Comment: Standard 3.5 mm zip tie slot thickness with FDM clearance.

Name: m3_nut_pocket_af
Comment: M3 hex nut pocket AF for FDM. ISO = 5.50 mm + 0.20 mm clearance.

Name: m3_nut_pocket_depth
Comment: M3 hex nut pocket depth. ISO height 2.40 + 0.20 mm.

Name: m3_nut_pocket_circum
Comment: M3 hex nut circumscribed circle + clearance for polygon-pocket method.

Name: m3_sq_nut_pocket_width
Comment: M3 square nut pocket width. ISO 5.50 + 0.20 mm.

Name: m3_sq_nut_pocket_depth
Comment: M3 square nut pocket depth. ISO 1.80 + 0.20 mm.

Name: m4_nut_pocket_af
Comment: M4 hex nut pocket AF. ISO 7.00 + 0.20 mm.

Name: m4_nut_pocket_depth
Comment: M4 hex nut pocket depth. ISO 3.20 + 0.20 mm.

Name: m5_nut_pocket_af
Comment: M5 hex nut pocket AF. ISO 8.00 + 0.20 mm.

Name: m5_nut_pocket_depth
Comment: M5 hex nut pocket depth. ISO 4.00 + 0.20 mm.

Name: m2_button_cbore_dia
Comment: M2 button-head counterbore dia. ISO head 3.80 + 0.40 mm FDM.

Name: m2_button_cbore_depth
Comment: M2 button-head counterbore depth. ISO head 0.90 + 0.30 mm.

Name: m2p5_button_cbore_dia
Comment: M2.5 button-head counterbore dia. ISO head 4.70 + 0.40 mm.

Name: m2p5_button_cbore_depth
Comment: M2.5 button-head counterbore depth. ISO head 1.30 + 0.30 mm.

Name: m3_button_cbore_dia
Comment: M3 button-head counterbore dia. ISO head 5.70 + 0.40 mm. Voron standard.

Name: m3_button_cbore_depth
Comment: M3 button-head counterbore depth. ISO head 1.65 + 0.30 mm.

Name: m3_socket_cbore_dia
Comment: M3 socket cap counterbore dia. ISO head 5.50 + 0.40 mm.

Name: m3_socket_cbore_depth
Comment: M3 socket cap counterbore depth. ISO head 3.00 + 0.30 mm.

Name: m4_button_cbore_dia
Comment: M4 button-head counterbore dia. ISO head 7.60 + 0.40 mm.

Name: m4_button_cbore_depth
Comment: M4 button-head counterbore depth. ISO head 2.20 + 0.30 mm.

Name: m5_button_cbore_dia
Comment: M5 button-head counterbore dia.

Name: countersink_angle
Comment: ISO metric flat-head included angle. 90° — NOT 82° (that is inch/UNC).

Name: m3_countersink_dia
Comment: M3 flat-head countersink top opening. ISO head 5.50 + 0.50 mm.

Name: m4_countersink_dia
Comment: M4 flat-head countersink top opening.

Name: fdm_thread_offset_petg
Comment: Offset Face per thread flank for PETG/ABS printed threads. Apply to both bolt and nut/hole.

Name: fdm_thread_offset_pla
Comment: Offset Face per flank for PLA. PLA prints tighter; slightly less clearance needed.

Name: fdm_thread_tol_petg
Comment: ISO Metric Thread Profile add-in tolerance for PETG/ABS. Sweet spot 0.40–0.60 mm.

Name: fdm_thread_tol_pla
Comment: ISO Metric Thread Profile add-in tolerance for PLA.

Name: m2_thread_pitch
Comment: M2 coarse thread pitch. Reference for thread tool.

Name: m2p5_thread_pitch
Comment: M2.5 coarse thread pitch.

Name: m3_thread_pitch
Comment: M3 coarse thread pitch.

Name: m4_thread_pitch
Comment: M4 coarse thread pitch.

Name: m5_thread_pitch
Comment: M5 coarse thread pitch.

Name: m6_thread_pitch
Comment: M6 coarse thread pitch.

Name: fdm_wall_minimum
Comment: Minimum functional wall — 2 perimeters. Non-structural enclosures only.

Name: fdm_wall_structural
Comment: Standard structural wall — 4 perimeters. Voron default for load-bearing features.

Name: fdm_wall_heavy
Comment: Heavy-duty — 6 perimeters. Motor mounts, idler towers, sustained dynamic loads.

Name: fdm_fillet_min
Comment: Minimum internal fillet to prevent delamination. 2× layer height.

Name: fdm_fillet_standard
Comment: Standard external edge fillet — aesthetics and chipping resistance.

Name: fdm_fillet_large
Comment: Large gusset fillet for high-stress junctions (toolhead arms, motor mounts).

Name: fdm_chamfer_standard
Comment: Standard 45° chamfer for edge breaking and hole lead-ins.

Name: fdm_chamfer_leadin
Comment: Larger lead-in chamfer for pin/shaft insertion guidance.

Name: fdm_overhang_max
Comment: Max unsupported overhang from vertical on standard machines.

Name: fdm_overhang_max_cpap
Comment: Max overhang with aggressive cooling (CPAP). K3 with SLM XY can reliably hit 65–70°.

Name: fdm_bridge_max
Comment: Max bridge span on well-tuned FDM at 30–60 mm/s bridging speed. Highly material-dependent.

Name: fdm_bridge_sag
Comment: Z compensation for bridge sag on long spans — raise ceiling by this amount.

Name: magnet_6x2mm_od
Comment: 6×2 mm N52 neodymium disc magnet OD. Very common for panel clips and small latches.

Name: magnet_6x2mm_height
Comment: 6×2 mm magnet height.

Name: magnet_6x3mm_od
Comment: 6×3 mm disc magnet OD.

Name: magnet_6x3mm_height
Comment: 6×3 mm disc magnet height.

Name: magnet_8x2mm_od
Comment: 8×2 mm N52 disc magnet OD. Common for toolhead docking (Tap, Klicky, etc.).

Name: magnet_8x2mm_height
Comment: 8×2 mm magnet height.

Name: magnet_10x2mm_od
Comment: 10×2 mm N52 disc magnet OD. Common for enclosure door catches and panel latches.

Name: magnet_10x2mm_height
Comment: 10×2 mm magnet height.

Name: magnet_10x3mm_od
Comment: 10×3 mm disc magnet OD.

Name: magnet_10x3mm_height
Comment: 10×3 mm magnet height.

Name: magnet_press_fit
Comment: Magnet pocket press-fit clearance per side. Model pocket SMALLER than magnet OD by this. Magnet will require a press — use a flat surface and tap gently.

Name: magnet_glue_gap
Comment: Magnet pocket clearance per side for CA/epoxy retention. Magnet drops in freely; adhesive fills the gap. Do not use press fit if gluing.

Name: magnet_flush_recess
Comment: Recess magnet below surface by this amount so it doesn't protrude. Protruding magnets interfere with flush mating surfaces.

Name: mgn7h_rail_width
Comment: MGN7H linear rail nominal width. Lightweight option for low-mass toolheads.

Name: mgn9h_rail_width
Comment: MGN9H rail nominal width.

Name: mgn12h_rail_width
Comment: MGN12H rail nominal width. Standard on V-Core 3.1 AWD Y and Z.

Name: mgn15h_rail_width
Comment: MGN15H rail nominal width. Heavy-duty gantry / Z axes.

Name: mgn12h_carriage_length
Comment: MGN12H H-type carriage block length. Used for toolhead plate sizing and hole pattern layout.

Name: mgn12h_pitch_along
Comment: MGN12H carriage mounting hole pitch — along rail axis.

Name: mgn12h_pitch_across
Comment: MGN12H carriage mounting hole pitch — perpendicular to rail axis.

Name: mgn9h_pitch_along
Comment: MGN9H carriage mounting hole pitch along rail.

Name: mgn9h_pitch_across
Comment: MGN9H carriage mounting hole pitch across rail.

Name: gt2_belt_pitch
Comment: GT2 / 3MGT belt tooth pitch. Standard for K3, V-Core, Voron.

Name: gt2_belt_width
Comment: GT2 / 3MGT belt nominal width.

Name: gt2_clamp_extra
Comment: Extra width in belt clamp slot for insertion and tensioning clearance.

Name: gt2_pulley_16t_od
Comment: GT2 16-tooth pulley OD (approximate). Verify per brand — varies ±0.3 mm.

Name: gt2_pulley_20t_od
Comment: GT2 20-tooth pulley OD (approximate). Most common idler/drive pulley size.

Name: gt2_pulley_80t_od
Comment: GT2 80-tooth pulley OD. Used in some AWD / geared arrangements.

Name: gt2_pulley_bore
Comment: Standard GT2 pulley shaft bore — 5 mm. Add 0.05 mm clearance for FDM shaft receivers.

Name: f695_bearing_od
Comment: F695 flanged bearing OD — standard GT2 idler bearing in Voron/K3/V-Core.

Name: f695_bearing_id
Comment: F695 bearing ID — fits M5 shoulder bolt.

Name: f695_bearing_width
Comment: F695 bearing width.

Name: nema17_body_width
Comment: NEMA17 motor body width (square). Standard across all NEMA17 motors.

Name: nema17_bolt_pattern_center_to_center
Comment: NEMA17 mounting bolt pattern — center to center (square pattern).

Name: nema17_bolt_size
Comment: NEMA17 mounting bolt — M3. Model clearance holes at hole_geometry_m3_screw_clearance_diameter.

Name: nema17_shaft_diameter
Comment: NEMA17 output shaft diameter. Standard 5 mm.

Name: nema17_shaft_flat_depth
Comment: NEMA17 shaft D-flat depth. Used for set screw / grub screw engagement geometry.

Name: nema17_shaft_length_standard
Comment: NEMA17 standard shaft length — 20 mm. Some variants: 22, 24 mm. Verify your specific motor.

Name: nema17_face_boss_diameter
Comment: NEMA17 front face centering boss diameter. Used for precision motor registration in mounts.

Name: nema14_body_width
Comment: NEMA14 motor body width — used in compact extruder motors (Orbiter, Sherpa Mini).

Name: nema14_bolt_pattern_center_to_center
Comment: NEMA14 mounting bolt pattern C-C.

Name: nema14_shaft_diameter
Comment: NEMA14 output shaft diameter.

Name: vslot_2020_extrusion_width
Comment: 2020 V-slot extrusion nominal width.

Name: vslot_2040_extrusion_width
Comment: 2040 extrusion nominal width.

Name: tslot_m3_nut_slot_clearance_width
Comment: M3 T-slot nut / hammerhead sliding width in 2020 extrusion. ISO slot = 5.50 + 0.20 mm clearance.

Name: beacon_probe_body_outer_diameter
Comment: Beacon eddy-current probe body OD. Used for mount bore and retention clip geometry.

Name: beacon_probe_body_total_length
Comment: Beacon probe body total length. Verify against your Beacon revision.

Name: orbiter_v25_motor_mount_bolt_pattern
Comment: Orbiter v2.5 extruder mounting bolt pattern C-C (NEMA14 pattern).

Name: orbiter_v25_filament_path_offset_from_mount
Comment: Orbiter v2.5 filament centerline offset from mount face. Used for toolhead geometry validation.

Name: chube_hotend_collet_outer_diameter
Comment: Chube Conduction hotend collet OD. Used for retention clip bore and mount pocket. Verify with your unit.

Name: canbus_cable_chain_slot_width
Comment: CAN bus toolhead umbilical cable chain slot minimum width. Accounts for cable bundle + connector bodies.

Name: toolhead_plate_5mm
Comment: V-Core toolhead carriage CNC plate thickness — 5 mm 6061-T6 as used in Wishbone toolhead architecture.

Name: toolhead_plate_4mm
Comment: K3 / secondary toolhead plate thickness — 4 mm 6061-T6.

Name: cnc_plate_tolerance
Comment: Mill tolerance on 6061-T6 stock plate thickness — typically ±0.05–0.10 mm. Account for this in stack height calculations when combining printed and machined parts.

Name: cnc_drilled_oversize
Comment: Drilled hole tolerance in aluminum — typically +0.05/−0.00 mm. For precision fits, always ream to H7 class after drilling.

Name: cnc_h7_ream_tol
Comment: H7 reamed hole tolerance for a 5 mm hole — ±0.006 mm. Reference for press-fit dowel pins and bearing seats in 6061.

Name: cnc_m2_tap_drill
Comment: M2×0.4 tap drill diameter in aluminum — ISO standard pre-tap hole for ~75% thread engagement.

Name: cnc_m2p5_tap_drill
Comment: M2.5×0.45 tap drill diameter in aluminum.

Name: cnc_m3_tap_drill
Comment: M3×0.5 tap drill diameter in aluminum — standard for all M3 tapped holes in 6061 toolhead plates.

Name: cnc_m4_tap_drill
Comment: M4×0.7 tap drill diameter in aluminum.

Name: cnc_m5_tap_drill
Comment: M5×0.8 tap drill diameter in aluminum.

Name: cnc_m6_tap_drill
Comment: M6×1.0 tap drill diameter in aluminum.

Name: cnc_thread_engage_min_ratio
Comment: Minimum thread engagement length = bolt_diameter × this ratio. M3 in 4 mm plate = 4.0 mm engagement > 1.5× = OK. Below 1× risks strip-out under load.

Name: cnc_thread_engage_rec_ratio
Comment: Recommended thread engagement for structural joints = 2× bolt diameter. M3 structural: 6 mm minimum engagement.

Name: cnc_min_wall_tap
Comment: Minimum material wall thickness surrounding a tapped hole in aluminum. Thinner risks thread pullout and wall blowout.

Name: cnc_m3_csink_4mm
Comment: Countersink depth for a flush M3 flat-head screw in a 4 mm plate. ISO M3 flat head height = 1.70 mm.

Name: cnc_m3_csink_5mm
Comment: Same countersink depth for 5 mm plate — flat head fully recessed with 3.30 mm of uncut material remaining.

Name: cnc_pocket_depth_tol
Comment: Typical pocket depth tolerance achievable from most CNC services — ±0.05 mm. Tighter than this requires premium machining.

Name: cnc_5mm_press_fit_pin
Comment: 5 mm H7 press-fit dowel hole in 6061 — nominal 5.000 mm −0.006 mm = 4.994 mm lower bound. Requires reaming.

Name: cnc_thermal_expansion
Comment: 6061-T6 linear thermal expansion coefficient — ~23.6 µm/m/°C ≈ 0.08 µm/mm/°C. Relevant for chamber-heated assemblies where aluminum and plastic expand at different rates.

Name: cnc_em_6mm_dia
Comment: 6mm single-flute roughing endmill diameter. Primary roughing tool for Carvera Air aluminum work.

Name: cnc_em_6mm_corner_r
Comment: Corner radius on 6mm endmill — not truly sharp. Design internal corners with at least this radius.

Name: cnc_em_3175_dia
Comment: 1/8 inch single-flute finishing endmill diameter. Primary finishing tool.

Name: cnc_em_3175_corner_r
Comment: Corner radius on 1/8 inch endmill.

Name: cnc_em_2mm_dia
Comment: 2mm ball endmill diameter. For filament half-bores and small radii.

Name: cnc_min_internal_r
Comment: Minimum internal corner radius for finish-machined pockets. Equals finishing endmill radius (3.175/2).

Name: cnc_min_internal_r_rough

Name: pip_sphere_clearance
Comment: Radial gap between captive sphere and socket for print-in-place FDM. Must exceed layer height to prevent fusion. Tested on 0.20 mm layers — reduce to 0.25 for 0.12 mm layers.

Name: pip_sphere_min_dia
Comment: Minimum sphere diameter for reliable print-in-place captive joints. Below this the bridge spans become too short for clean FDM.

Name: pip_hinge_clearance
Comment: Radial clearance for print-in-place living hinge pins. Tighter than captive sphere since rotation axis is fixed.

Name: bayonet_rotation_angle
Comment: Rotation angle to lock/unlock. Must be less than (360/tab_count - entry_slot_angle) to avoid tab running into next entry slot.

Name: bayonet_tab_height
Comment: Radial height of each locking tab (how far it protrudes into the channel). Determines pull-off resistance.

Name: bayonet_channel_depth
Comment: Depth of rotation channel in mating part. Tab height + clearance for smooth rotation.

Name: bayonet_entry_slot_width
Comment: Angular width of entry slot where tab drops in before rotating to lock. Must be wide enough for easy alignment.

Name: bayonet_ramp_angle
Comment: Optional ramp angle at channel end — creates a detent that resists accidental unlocking. 0 = no detent, 5 = light snap, 10 = firm.

Name: bayonet_engagement_depth
Comment: How far the lid collar overlaps the container body. Deeper = more stable but harder to print overhangs internally.

Name: bayonet_clearance_radial
Comment: Radial clearance between lid inner wall and container outer wall. Uses sliding fit class.

Name: dovetail_angle
Comment: Dovetail half-angle (from vertical). 60° is standard for FDM — provides retention without excessive overhang. 45° also printable but weaker lock.

Name: dovetail_base_width
Comment: Width at narrow end (base) of dovetail tail. Scale up for larger load-bearing joints.

Name: dovetail_top_width
Comment: Width at wide end (top) of dovetail tail. Difference from base determines lock strength.

Name: dovetail_depth
Comment: Depth of dovetail slot/rail. Deeper = stronger retention but more material.

Name: dovetail_clearance
Comment: Per-surface clearance for sliding dovetail fit in FDM. Tighter than general sliding fit because dovetails self-align.

Name: dovetail_chamfer
Comment: Lead-in chamfer at dovetail entry to ease assembly. Applied to both rail and slot.

Name: spring_clip_thick
Comment: Flexure arm thickness for FDM spring clips (PLA). Thinner = more flex but weaker. 1.6 mm gives ~2 mm deflection before yield at 40 mm arm length.

Name: spring_clip_width
Comment: Width of spring clip arm. Wider = stiffer (scales linearly with width).

Name: spring_clip_max_flex
Comment: Maximum safe deflection for PLA spring clip arms at 1.6 mm thickness × 40 mm length. Beyond this risks permanent deformation.

Name: spring_clip_hook_depth
Comment: How far the hook protrudes past the mating surface. Must be less than max deflection for the arm to flex over it.

Name: container_wall
Comment: Minimum wall thickness for food-adjacent containers (treats, dry goods). Provides structural rigidity and prevents permeation. Not FDA-rated — for dry pet treats only.

Name: container_base
Comment: Base/floor thickness for general containers. Thicker than walls because bottom bears load and is the first layer group.

Name: container_corner_r
Comment: Minimum corner radius for rounded-rectangle containers. Smaller radii create stress concentrations and thin-wall issues in FDM.

Name: container_rim_width
Comment: Width of the sealing rim/lip on container lids. Provides contact area for dust seal without excessive material.

Name: fdm_living_hinge_thick
Comment: Single-layer living hinge thickness. Two layers at 0.4mm nozzle. Prints flat then folds along hinge line.

Name: fdm_living_hinge_width
Comment: Minimum width for reliable FDM living hinge. Narrower hinges concentrate stress and crack.

Name: fdm_living_hinge_radius
Comment: Minimum bend radius for FDM living hinge. Tighter radii crack on first fold in PLA.

Name: fdm_text_min_height
Comment: Minimum embossed or debossed text height for legibility at 0.4mm nozzle. Smaller text loses detail.

Name: fdm_text_depth
Comment: Deboss depth or emboss height for text features. Three layers at 0.20mm layer height.

Name: fdm_rib_thickness
Comment: Reinforcement rib thickness. Matches fdm_wall_minimum for consistent perimeter fill.

Name: fdm_rib_height_max
Comment: Maximum rib height before deflection issues. Approximately 10x rib thickness.

Name: fdm_draft_angle
Comment: Minimum draft angle for FDM mold-style features and vertical snap-fit guides.

Name: asm_fdm_to_cnc_clearance
Comment: Interface clearance between FDM and CNC mating surfaces. Accounts for FDM dimensional variation against precision aluminum.

Name: asm_fdm_to_fdm_clearance
Comment: Interface clearance between two FDM mating surfaces. Both parts have FDM tolerances.

Name: asm_cnc_to_cnc_clearance
Comment: Interface clearance between two CNC mating surfaces. Both parts are precision machined.

Name: asm_stackup_budget_fdm
Comment: Per-part tolerance budget for FDM parts in a tolerance stack. Multiply by number of FDM parts in chain.

Name: asm_stackup_budget_cnc
Comment: Per-part tolerance budget for CNC parts in a tolerance stack. Multiply by number of CNC parts in chain.

Name: snapfit_beam_length
Comment: Cantilever beam length from root to hook tip. 20 mm gives safe deflection at 1.2% root strain in PLA. Shorter = stiffer = higher insertion force.

Name: snapfit_beam_thick
Comment: Beam thickness (bending axis). At 20 mm length allows ~1.5 mm deflection before yield in PLA. Integer multiple of fdm_line_width for clean wall fill.

Name: snapfit_beam_width
Comment: Beam width — stiffness scales linearly. 6 mm provides sufficient hook contact area. Minimum 4x fdm_line_width.

Name: snapfit_hook_depth
Comment: Hook undercut depth — how far hook protrudes past mating lip. Must be less than max safe deflection (1.5 mm at 20 mm beam). Deeper = stronger retention.

Name: snapfit_entry_angle
Comment: Insertion ramp angle from beam axis. 30 deg = moderate insertion force. Steeper = easier entry but shallower hook. Must be < fdm_overhang_max.

Name: snapfit_retention_angle
Comment: Retention face angle from beam axis. 80 deg = strong pull-out resistance. 90 deg = permanent snap (destructive removal only).

Name: snapfit_clearance
Comment: Gap between beam sides and guide channel walls. References sliding fit for smooth deflection travel.

Name: snapfit_root_fillet
Comment: Fillet radius at beam root to prevent stress concentration and delamination. Critical for fatigue life — minimum 1x beam thickness.

Name: snaplatch_arm_length
Comment: Latch arm length from pivot to hook tip. Shorter than snapfit because latch arms are wider and stiffer. 12 mm balances finger accessibility with stiffness.

Name: snaplatch_arm_thick
Comment: Arm thickness. Slightly thicker than snapfit for durability under repeated cycling. 4x fdm_line_width = clean perimeter fill.

Name: snaplatch_arm_width
Comment: Arm width. Wider than snapfit for better grip surface and lateral stability. User must be able to pinch and lift the latch.

Name: snaplatch_hook_depth
Comment: How far latch hook engages behind mating lip. 1 mm provides positive click-shut feel without requiring tools to open.

Name: snaplatch_lip_thick
Comment: Thickness of mating lip on container body that latch catches behind. Must survive repeated latch impact without cracking. Minimum fdm_wall_structural.

Name: snaplatch_lift_tab_height
Comment: Height of finger lift tab extending past hook. User must get a fingernail under this to release. Minimum 2.5 mm for usability.

Name: snaplatch_clearance
Comment: Clearance between latch arm and guide slot walls. References fdm_sliding_fit.

Name: detent_ball_dia
Comment: Steel ball bearing diameter. 4 mm is widely available and large enough for positive tactile click. 3 mm also common — scale bore accordingly.

Name: detent_bore_dia
Comment: Bore that retains the ball. Ball must not fall through — bore is ball_dia + 2x fdm_hole_shrink. Lip retains ball at equator.

Name: detent_bore_depth
Comment: Depth of ball bore behind mating surface. Accommodates ball + spring or flexure. 1.5x ball diameter minimum.

Name: detent_dimple_dia
Comment: Diameter of mating detent dimple (cone/sphere indent). Smaller than ball so ball seats positively. 75% of ball dia is standard.

Name: detent_dimple_depth
Comment: Depth of dimple indent. Controls retention force — deeper = stronger click but harder to pop out. 0.8 mm gives moderate detent feel with 4 mm ball.

Name: detent_spring_thick
Comment: Thickness of printed leaf spring behind ball (if using printed flexure instead of metal spring). Thinner = lighter detent click.

Name: detent_spring_length
Comment: Free length of printed leaf spring. Longer = softer spring rate = lighter click. At 1.2 mm thick and 10 mm long PLA gives ~2-4 N preload.

Name: quarterturn_stud_dia
Comment: Stud shaft diameter. 8 mm provides sufficient shear strength in PLA for panel retention. Must clear the keyhole slot width.

Name: quarterturn_head_dia
Comment: Stud head diameter (locking flange that catches behind panel). Extends past keyhole to provide bearing area. Minimum 1.5x stud_dia.

Name: quarterturn_head_thick
Comment: Thickness of locking head flange. Must resist bending from pull-out loads. Minimum fdm_wall_structural.

Name: quarterturn_keyhole_width
Comment: Width of keyhole entry slot in panel. Stud shaft passes through this. stud_dia + 2x fdm_sliding_fit + margin.

Name: quarterturn_keyhole_length
Comment: Length of keyhole slot (allows head to pass through during insertion). head_dia + 2x fdm_sliding_fit + margin.

Name: quarterturn_panel_thick
Comment: Nominal panel thickness the fastener is designed for. Stud shoulder height matches this so head sits flush behind panel.

Name: quarterturn_clearance
Comment: Radial clearance between stud and keyhole for smooth rotation. References fdm_sliding_fit.

Name: quarterturn_detent_depth
Comment: Depth of 90-degree detent notch that holds fastener in locked position. Provides tactile click at lock. Shallow = easy release.

Name: camlock_cam_dia
Comment: Outer diameter of cam disc. 15 mm is standard for furniture-style cam locks. Larger = more clamping force at same eccentricity.

Name: camlock_eccentricity
Comment: Offset between cam center and pivot bore center. This IS the total clamping travel. 1.5 mm provides firm clamp without excessive torque.

Name: camlock_cam_thick
Comment: Cam disc thickness. Determines bearing area against mating slot. 6 mm prevents cam from cocking/tilting under load.

Name: camlock_pivot_dia
Comment: Pivot shaft diameter through cam center bore. 5 mm aligns with common dowel pin or M5 bolt sizes.

Name: camlock_slot_width
Comment: Width of slot the cam bears against in mating part. cam_thick + 2x fdm_sliding_fit + margin for smooth rotation.

Name: camlock_lever_length
Comment: Length of operating lever arm (if integrated). Provides mechanical advantage for hand operation. Can be replaced with screwdriver slot.

Name: camlock_clearance
Comment: Radial clearance between cam disc and housing pocket. References fdm_sliding_fit for smooth rotation.

Comment: Pi Zero mounting hole pitch (long axis).

Name: din_rail_depth
Comment: TS35 top-hat DIN rail depth (also a 15 mm deep variant). Source: EN 60715

Name: header_pitch
Comment: Standard 0.1 in header/breadboard/protoboard pin pitch.

Name: dovetail_mount_width
Comment: BB3D house mount-rail dovetail width at the wide (face) edge. Load-bearing wall-holder rail, larger than the generic dovetail_* joint. Lock once - never change.

Name: dovetail_mount_depth
Comment: House mount-rail dovetail engagement depth. Narrow-edge width = 24 - 2*(depth/tan(angle)) ~= 17.1 mm at 60 deg.

Name: dovetail_mount_angle
Comment: House mount-rail flank angle measured from the part face (mating plane). 60 deg = 30 deg undercut from vertical: strong lock, prints clean without support.

Name: dovetail_mount_clearance
Comment: Per-surface slide clearance for the mount rail. Looser than dovetail_clearance (0.12) because the rail is larger and longer-travel.

Name: gear_pressure_angle
Comment: Involute pressure angle for FDM/industry gears. 20 deg = stronger teeth, tolerant of center-distance error; 14.5 deg is legacy. Source: AGMA/ISO.

Name: gear_module_fine
Comment: Fine gear module (small toys/mechanisms). Pitch dia = module x teeth. Two-gear center distance (the 'spacing') = module x (z1+z2)/2. Source: meta-matic/EngineerDog.

Name: gear_module_standard
Comment: General-purpose FDM gear module (robots, DIY, fidget gear stacks).

Name: gear_module_coarse
Comment: Coarse module for higher-torque / robust FDM gears.

Name: gear_backlash
Comment: Total backlash between two meshing FDM gears printed SEPARATELY (~0.15 mm/gear). Apply as tooth thinning or +center distance; tune to printer. Source: FDM gear guides.

Name: gear_pip_clearance
Comment: Per-surface clearance for PRINT-IN-PLACE gears (planetary fidgets) at 0.2 mm layer / 0.4 mm nozzle. ~0.1-0.2: tighter binds, looser rattles. Source: Printables PIP-fidget makers.

Name: gear_addendum_factor
Comment: Addendum (tooth height above pitch circle) = this x module. ISO standard 1.0. Dimensionless.

Name: gear_dedendum_factor
Comment: Dedendum (depth below pitch circle) = this x module; includes root clearance. Dimensionless.

Name: gear_tip_clearance_factor
Comment: Tip-to-root clearance = this x module. Whole tooth depth = (addendum+dedendum) = 2.25 x module. Dimensionless.

Name: gear_min_teeth
Comment: Min teeth to avoid undercut on FDM 20 deg gears (theoretical 17; 12-14 OK printed, profile-shift below ~17). Dimensionless count.

Name: bearing_r188_id
Comment: R188 bearing bore (1/4 in). Compact fidget-spinner bearing vs the larger 608.

Name: bearing_r188_od
Comment: R188 bearing OD (1/2 in). Source: Boca Bearings fidget guide.

Name: bearing_r188_width
Comment: R188 bearing width (3/16 in). Verify - some R188 ship 1/8 in (3.18 mm) wide.

Name: fidget_608_bearing_press
Comment: 608 bearing press-fit pocket ID for fidget-spinner caps (0.10 mm interference, FDM). For a slip-fit use bearing_608_od + 0.10 instead.

Name: fidget_r188_bearing_press
Comment: R188 bearing press-fit pocket ID for compact fidgets (0.10 mm interference).

Name: fidget_click_pitch
Comment: APPROX - tune. Center-to-center spacing between click/detent stops on a slider or dial fidget; sets the travel-per-click feel.

Name: fidget_click_bump
Comment: APPROX - tune. Ride-over bump/notch height that produces the tactile snap as a stop passes a detent. ~0.3-0.6 mm in PLA; bigger = stiffer click. See detent_* for a ball-detent click.

Name: fidget_magnet_snap_gap
Comment: APPROX - tune. Air gap held between moving and fixed magnets at a magnetic-slider click stop so they snap without contacting. Scale with magnet strength; see magnet_* sizes.

Name: hinge_pin_dia
Comment: Default print-in-place hinge pin diameter. Below ~2 mm gets fragile. Barrel bore = pin + 2x pip_hinge_clearance. Source: Snapmaker/Printables PIP hinge guides.

Name: hinge_pin_bore
Comment: Print-in-place hinge barrel bore ID = pin dia + 2x radial clearance (pip_hinge_clearance 0.25). 3.0 -> 3.5 mm.

Name: hinge_knuckle_gap
Comment: Axial (Z) air gap between stacked hinge knuckles so they do not fuse/bind. Use >= 1-2 layer heights; larger than XY pin clearance since Z is discrete. Source: Snapmaker PIP hinge guide.

Name: hinge_barrel_wall
Comment: Min wall around a hinge barrel bore (~4x line width) for strength.

Name: fidget_infinity_hinge_gap
Comment: All-around air gap for infinity-cube folding hinges - loose fit so cubes fold freely without separating. Source: Fusion 360 infinity-cube tutorials.

Name: fidget_button_travel
Comment: APPROX - tune. Depression distance of a printed fidget-cube clicky button before bottoming/clicking. 0.5-1.5 mm; more travel = bigger throw.

Name: fidget_button_cap_dia
Comment: APPROX. Typical fidget-cube button cap diameter.

Name: fidget_button_snap_height
Comment: APPROX - tune. Snap-through lip/dome height the button rides over to produce the click. See snapfit_*/detent_* for the underlying mechanism.
